Phase 0 establishes the 'Northstar' for Gemini Enterprise by defining three distinct tiers before deployment.

Establish multi-channel feedback streams to drive ongoing optimization and backlog refinement:
Dedicated community channel triaged weekly by AI Champions.
Telemetry reviewed weekly by the IT/Admin Lead.
Led by Adoption Lead to surface blockers and capture new Phase 2 ideas.
Prioritize the backlog by evaluating every use case captured in Phase 1 on a scale of 1 to 5 across three core criteria.
Measures the direct impact on revenue generation, cost savings, operational efficiency, or customer experience enhancements.
Assesses technical complexity, readiness of required infrastructure, and the availability of clean, accessible data.
Evaluates time-to-deployment, speed to deliver tangible impact, and potential for reuse across multiple operational teams.
must achieve formal sign-off and approval for full build execution before advancing out of Phase 2.
Evaluating regulatory and internal safety requirements before Phase 2 use cases go live.
Subject to industry frameworks such as HIPAA, GDPR, or SOC 2
Loop in Legal & Compliance teams immediately to review regulatory scope
Accidental exposure or ingestion of PII and PHI in prompts
Deploy SDP rules to automatically detect and redact sensitive data
External-facing agents vulnerable to unsafe or unexpected inputs
Evaluate and configure custom Model Armor safety filters
Cross-border data processing violating regional regulations
Review geographic boundaries for processing and storage compliance
Formal Legal and Compliance sign-off is a mandatory exit criterion before any prioritized Phase 2 use cases can proceed to live deployment.

BASELINE GOAL ALIGNMENT · PHASE 0 VISION REALIZATION
Establishing Baselines at Kickoff & Updating Status Each Review Cycle
Owned by the IT/Admin Lead. Focuses on system utilization, active weekly user growth, license distribution efficiency, and agent deployment velocity.
Owned by the Adoption Lead. Focuses on accelerating task completion, reducing workflow cycle times, scaling task automation, and maintaining high user CSAT.
Owned by the Executive Sponsor. Focuses on high-impact financial goals, support ticket deflection, operational cost reductions, and overall organizational ROI.
